headline: Mondelez (MDLZ) Tackles Cocoa Costs While Recalling Cadbury Oreo Candy Bar
summary: Mondelez International is progressing work on cell cultured chocolate technology as part of its response to cocoa price volatility in 2026. The company has also announced a nationwide recall of its Cadbury Dairy Milk Oreo Candy bar due to undeclared pistachio allergens. Both developments are material for consumers and investors in NasdaqGS:MDLZ, touching food safety, costs and product innovation.
